verdict.line: You lose if you let her land Test of Spirit and keep trading in melee range; you win by poking from range and denying her engage with Q.

brief.thesis: Illaoi has no ranged poke or gap closer beyond a 400-range W, so this matchup is decided entirely by whether you hold your range advantage or get walked down into melee. Every point of damage you take while linked by her E echoes back onto you, so the lane is really a test of discipline, not damage output, which is why the head-to-head sits dead even at 51.9% over 605 games.

theirWindow.when: Right after Test of Spirit lands on you
theirWindow.what: Disengage immediately instead of trading back. Damage the spirit takes echoes to you, and if it dies or drifts too far from her you become a Vessel that spawns extra tentacles against you for free.

yourWindow.when: Whenever she leaps in with W
yourWindow.what: Harsh Lesson only reaches 400 range while your autos and Toxic Shot poison reach 680, so step back the instant she commits. Land Q (Blinding Dart, 8s cooldown) as she closes to strip her autos and tentacle procs for the duration.

powerCurve.note: You outrange her with zero gap closer
Q blind cripples any all-in attempt
R adds AoE engage and tentacle healing
Shiv online, kiting still answers dives

start.why: The 52.6% win rate, 68.4%-pick start on this matchup gives you the mana sustain to spam Q (Blinding Dart) and Toxic Shot autos all lane without going OOM, which is how you keep poking instead of being forced into melee trades.

boots.why: Raw movement speed compounds with Move Quick's passive bonus to keep you permanently outside her 400-range W, and it measures higher here (54.6% vs 51.8% for Sorcerer's Shoes) against a melee duelist who has no way to close the gap otherwise.

core.why: Attack speed accelerates how often Toxic Shot's poison procs land, and the on-hit bolt gives you a ranged poke tool that doesn't require stepping into her tentacle range.
The burn ticks continue after you disengage, so it punishes her high base HP and keeps dealing damage even once you've kited back out of melee.
The cooldown reduction lets you drop Q and R more often to keep her blinded and the lane zoned, stacking with the highest-win-rate finished build (51.6% over 219 games).

situational.when: she drops low and you need extra burst to close out the trade before she disengages
she itemizes around healing or lifesteal to offset tentacle sustain
the game runs long and you need more attack speed and cooldown for extended poke wars

runes.keystoneWhy: It rewards three consecutive hits, which your autos and Toxic Shot already provide from range, converting your poke advantage directly into burst and a damage-amp window instead of requiring you to commit to a full all-in like she does.

summoners.why: This is the dominant pick at 92.8% and the highest win rate (53.4%). Ignite punishes her all-in attempts since she has no cleanse or heal in her kit, and Flash is your out when she manages to close distance or catch you with R (Leap of Faith).

playing.title: Hold Q for her engage
playing.detail: Save Blinding Dart for the moment she commits with W or walks up to auto. It won't stop her abilities from activating, but it strips the auto-attack damage and tentacle procs that make her trades worthwhile.

playing.title: Kite with W, don't facetank
playing.detail: Keep Move Quick's passive speed active by not getting struck. Weave an attack, then immediately step out of her 400-range W before she can tag you again.

playing.title: Break her E link instantly
playing.detail: If Test of Spirit lands, disengage rather than trade back. Letting the spirit die or drift too far turns you into a Vessel that spawns tentacles against you.

playing.title: Avoid walls and jungle terrain
playing.detail: Her passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassable terrain, so fighting next to walls or brush edges hands her free extra damage and healing. Pull trades into open lane space.

playing.title: Respect R past level 6
playing.detail: Leap of Faith hits every nearby enemy and spawns a tentacle for each champion it catches, with only a 120s cooldown at rank 1. Don't stand in melee range near 6+ unless you've tracked it down.

playing.title: Poke, don't all-in, pre-6
playing.detail: Your autos and Toxic Shot outrange her entire kit before level 6. Win the lane with Doran's Ring-sustained poke rather than committing to full trades.

playing.title: Trap her recall path
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown per cast, so drop several over the brush or chokepoint she retreats through to punish her backs and deny vision.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the ability readings, timing windows, and lane plan are my own tactical analysis built on top of that data.
